title: Fleet data partner sync
content: Ask about their tanker coverage outside the Gulf.
summary:
### Context and Goals
- The partner wants earlier warning of AIS gaps on vessels they insure.

### Discussion
- Their ops team reviews gaps by hand today.
- Our gap report already flags dark periods over six hours.

### Next Steps
- Frank to send the AIS gap report sample by Friday.
- Partner to share three vessels for the trial.

### Decisions Made
- Trial runs for four weeks from 19 October.
